blocks.text: Sulfur is used as a cross-linker for rubber molecular chains; this is vulcanisation, and it improves the strength of rubber (Figure 12.10: S-S cross-links between polymer chains).

blocks.prompt: What is the role of sulfur in the vulcanisation of rubber (exercise Q.2k)?
blocks.explanation: Heated with raw rubber, sulfur forms S-S bridges between neighbouring polymer chains. The chains can no longer slide freely past one another, so the rubber becomes stronger, more elastic and less sticky or brittle with temperature.

items: Vulcanisation: sulfur cross-links rubber chains with S-S bridges, improving strength.
